source: 30-page Premium run 2026-09-26-2214, accepted map immediately before integrity regeneration

briefs.title: Four Lights on the Path
briefs.summary: Rabbit and Wise Turtle prepare the woodland path for a picnic, then a gust scatters its four lanterns.

pages.purpose: Stage the storm’s sudden theft of all four path lights.
pages.beat: Stage the openingHook: a gust snatches all four lanterns from their hooks just as Rabbit reaches for the picnic basket; their glass stays whole, but the path goes dark.
pages.endingPressure: With the basket in reach and the path dark, which light can Rabbit find first?
requiredContinuity: All four lanterns are torn from their assigned hooks, with their glass intact.
Rabbit is at the picnic basket; the path is dark.

pages.purpose: Empty hooks reveal the scattered route
pages.beat: Turtle checks Brook Bend, Fern Gate, Stump Turn, and Fork; Rabbit urges a quick search.
pages.endingPressure: Rabbit's impatience pulls against Turtle's checks.
requiredContinuity: Original order: Red–Brook Bend, Blue–Fern Gate, Gold–Stump Turn, Green–Fork.
Turtle finds all four hooks empty.

pages.purpose: Rabbit separates from Turtle to search
pages.beat: Rabbit bolts east alone to find Red, while Turtle stays at Brook Bend to check the storm-tossed path.
pages.endingPressure: Rabbit's solo search risks a rushed mistake.
requiredContinuity: Turtle stays at Brook Bend.
Rabbit searches east alone; no lantern is found yet.

briefs.title: Rabbit’s Quick Fix
briefs.summary: Rabbit finds Red beyond Stump Turn and rushes it to the wrong arm of the Fork.

pages.purpose: Rabbit’s unplanned loop costs precious search time.
pages.beat: Darting without an order, Rabbit overshoots Stump Turn, loops back through the same leaf-whirled bend, and loses time before searching east.
pages.endingPressure: The moon is still below the treetops, but Rabbit has lost time and found no lantern.
requiredContinuity: Rabbit searches alone east of Stump Turn after looping back.
No lantern has been found or moved.

pages.purpose: Rabbit finds the first displaced lantern intact.
pages.beat: Past Stump Turn, Rabbit spots Red lying on the east side, its glass still intact.
pages.endingPressure: Red’s wrong location tempts Rabbit to move it before checking with Turtle.
requiredContinuity: Red lies east of Stump Turn, intact and unmoved.
Rabbit is alone; Turtle does not yet know Red’s landing place.

pages.purpose: Red’s wrong glow sends Rabbit down the wrong arm.
pages.beat: Rabbit carries intact Red to the Fork’s north arm and hangs it there; its glow sends him down the wrong branch, and he loops back alone to the Fork, realizing his quick fix has confused even his own route.
pages.endingPressure: Red still points north, and Turtle does not yet know where it landed or where Rabbit moved it.
requiredContinuity: Red is intact on the Fork’s north arm, not east of Stump Turn.
Rabbit has returned to the Fork alone; Turtle remains at Brook Bend.

briefs.title: Two Landing Places
briefs.summary: Rabbit tells Turtle where Red landed, and together they find Blue east of Fern Gate.

pages.purpose: Rabbit’s confession gives Turtle the true Red state.
pages.beat: Turtle follows the path from Brook Bend to the Fork; there Rabbit tells him Red landed east of Stump Turn and that he hung it on the north arm.
pages.endingPressure: The false glow still misdirects from the Fork, and they need another landing to compare.
requiredContinuity: Turtle travels from Brook Bend and meets Rabbit at the Fork.
Red remains intact on the north arm; Turtle now knows its landing and wrong placement.

pages.purpose: Blue supplies the second intact landing observation.
pages.beat: Together they search east of Fern Gate and find Blue grounded there, its glass whole; they leave it in place so they can compare its landing with Red’s.
pages.endingPressure: Two distinct eastward landings now await comparison.
requiredContinuity: Blue lies intact east of Fern Gate and remains unmoved.
Rabbit and Turtle know both Red’s and Blue’s observed landing places.

pages.purpose: Matching landings predict Gold's hiding place
pages.beat: Red east of Stump; Blue east of Fern: wind drift past barriers predicts Gold beyond Fork's east-pointing root.
pages.endingPressure: The prediction directs them beyond the Fork.
requiredContinuity: Rabbit and Turtle compare both landing places.
They predict Gold lies beyond the Fork's east-pointing root.

briefs.title: Beyond the Root
briefs.summary: The pair return Blue to Fern Gate, follow their prediction, and retrieve Gold from beyond the root.

pages.purpose: Blue returns intact to its assigned gate.
pages.beat: Rabbit lifts intact Blue from east of Fern Gate, carries it to its assigned hook, and hangs it there while Turtle steadies the post.
pages.endingPressure: Gold’s predicted hiding place beyond the root remains unsearched.
requiredContinuity: Blue is intact and hangs at Fern Gate.
Rabbit carried Blue; Red remains on the Fork’s north arm.

pages.purpose: Rabbit turns the prediction into a route
pages.beat: Rabbit leads straight toward the east-pointing root instead of retracing every station; Turtle follows his evidence.
pages.endingPressure: The predicted hiding place lies just ahead.
requiredContinuity: Rabbit leads Turtle toward the predicted search place.
Blue is restored at Fern Gate.

pages.purpose: Gold is freed and returned from the predicted hiding place.
pages.beat: Beyond the Fork’s east-pointing root, Turtle frees intact Gold from a snag and hands it to Rabbit; Rabbit carries it back past the Fork to Stump Turn and hangs it on its hook.
pages.endingPressure: Green remains missing, and moonrise draws nearer.
requiredContinuity: Gold is intact on its assigned hook at Stump Turn.
Rabbit carries Gold from beyond the root; Red remains on the Fork’s north arm.

briefs.title: A Different Route
briefs.summary: Turtle’s wish to recheck every old station clashes with Rabbit’s clue-based plan before moonrise.

pages.purpose: Turtle’s retracing habit costs real search time.
pages.beat: From Stump Turn, Turtle turns west and retraces to Fern Gate, rechecking Blue’s known hook while Rabbit follows; the repeat costs them time without locating Green.
pages.endingPressure: Green is still missing, and Rabbit must persuade Turtle to leave the completed checks behind.
requiredContinuity: Rabbit and Turtle move from Stump Turn to Fern Gate.
Blue is already restored there; Green remains missing and Red misplaced.

pages.purpose: Rabbit’s evidence changes Turtle’s search route.
pages.beat: At Fern Gate, Rabbit names Red east of Stump and Blue east of Fern; Turtle stops the repeat, trusts the evidence, and turns with Rabbit west toward the downstream rail without rechecking Brook Bend.
pages.endingPressure: The unsearched rail beyond Brook Bend lies ahead, with Green still missing.
requiredContinuity: Rabbit and Turtle leave Fern Gate westward toward the downstream rail.
Turtle has chosen evidence over another check of a restored station; Red remains on the Fork’s north arm.

pages.purpose: Green’s intact landing reveals the final retrieval challenge.
pages.beat: At the downstream rail beyond Brook Bend, Rabbit spots Green caught on a low branch across the shallow stream, on the far downstream bank; its glass is intact.
pages.endingPressure: The narrow stream separates them from the lantern.
requiredContinuity: Rabbit and Turtle reach the near bank at the downstream rail.
Green is intact, caught on a branch on the far downstream bank.

briefs.title: Green by the Rail
briefs.summary: Rabbit and Turtle retrieve Green from beyond the stream rail and carry it back to the Fork.

pages.purpose: The pair cross safely to Green’s bank.
pages.beat: At the rail, Turtle finds flat stepping-stones upstream, tests them, and crosses first; Rabbit follows, and both reach the downstream bank beside Green.
pages.endingPressure: Green remains caught and must be freed without cracking its glass.
requiredContinuity: Turtle crosses first over the stepping-stones; Rabbit follows.
Both finish on the downstream bank; Green remains caught and intact.

pages.purpose: Rabbit’s energy and Turtle’s care free Green together.
pages.beat: On the downstream bank, Rabbit braces the springing branch while Turtle frees intact Green and hands it to Rabbit; Turtle crosses back first, and Rabbit follows carrying the lantern.
pages.endingPressure: Rabbit carries Green toward its proper Fork post.
requiredContinuity: Turtle frees Green and transfers it to Rabbit on the downstream bank.
Turtle crosses to the near bank first; Rabbit follows carrying intact Green.

pages.purpose: Green returns to its proper Fork post
pages.beat: Rabbit carries Green to the Fork and hangs it on the proper post while Turtle steadies the hook.
pages.endingPressure: Red still misdirects from the Fork.
requiredContinuity: Green hangs at its proper post on the Fork.
Red remains on the Fork's north arm.

briefs.title: Putting Red Right
briefs.summary: Rabbit removes the misleading Red lantern and restores it to Brook Bend with Turtle beside him.

pages.purpose: Rabbit owns and begins correcting the mistake
pages.beat: Rabbit admits Red confused the Fork, lifts it, and carries it toward Brook Bend.
pages.endingPressure: The final misplaced lantern still needs its home.
requiredContinuity: Rabbit carries Red from the Fork toward Brook Bend.
Blue, Gold, and Green are correctly placed.

pages.purpose: Red is restored at Brook Bend
pages.beat: Rabbit hangs Red at Brook Bend; Turtle watches as Rabbit checks the hook instead of hurrying away.
pages.endingPressure: One complete station-by-station check remains.
requiredContinuity: Red hangs at Brook Bend.
All four lanterns are now restored.

pages.purpose: The restored path brings the pair to the entrance ready to guide.
pages.beat: With Red, Blue, Gold, and Green restored, Rabbit and Turtle walk from Brook Bend back to the path entrance; Turtle asks Rabbit to lead the neighbors at their pace, and Rabbit accepts by matching Turtle’s steady walk.
pages.endingPressure: The neighbors have not entered yet, but the pair are ready to meet them.
requiredContinuity: All four intact lanterns are correctly placed.
Rabbit and Turtle reach the entrance; the neighbors have not entered the path.

briefs.title: Neighbors at the Entrance
briefs.summary: When the neighbors arrive at the path entrance, Rabbit resists rushing ahead and explains how to follow the lights.

pages.purpose: Rabbit begins a shared, steady escort.
pages.beat: The neighbors arrive at the entrance after the four lights are restored; Rabbit starts to bound ahead, remembers the north-arm mistake, asks Turtle to confirm Red, listens as the group says it is ready, and leads everyone to Brook Bend at their walking pace.
pages.endingPressure: Fern Gate is next, and Rabbit must keep watching the group as well as the markers.
requiredContinuity: All four lanterns are restored before the neighbors enter.
The group moves from the entrance to Brook Bend; Red is correctly placed.

pages.purpose: Rabbit guides the neighbors to Blue without leaving anyone behind.
pages.beat: At Brook Bend, Rabbit waits until the last neighbor sees Red, then leads everyone at their pace to Fern Gate and points out Blue; Turtle falls to the rear and matches the walkers’ steps.
pages.endingPressure: Stump Turn and Gold lie ahead, with the group still together.
requiredContinuity: The group leaves Brook Bend and reaches Fern Gate together.
Red and Blue remain correctly placed; Turtle walks at the rear.

pages.purpose: Turtle’s steady observation helps the group read Gold’s marker.
pages.beat: Rabbit leads the group from Fern Gate to Stump Turn and points out Gold; Turtle notes how its steady glow falls across the dry trail, and Rabbit waits long enough for everyone to see before leading on.
pages.endingPressure: The Fork and Green are the next markers on the route.
requiredContinuity: The group moves from Fern Gate to Stump Turn together.
Gold remains correctly placed and visible.

briefs.title: The Lantern Path
briefs.summary: Rabbit leads the neighbors past the restored markers while Turtle adapts his pace to the group.

pages.purpose: Green confirms that the Fork is safe to follow.
pages.beat: At the Fork, Rabbit checks intact Green on its assigned post and names the clearing trail; Turtle gestures for Rabbit to choose the way, and Rabbit leads the neighbors onto it at their shared pace.
pages.endingPressure: The clearing is close, but the whole group must stay together on the final stretch.
requiredContinuity: The group reaches the Fork and Green is correctly placed.
Rabbit leads the group onto the clearing trail; Turtle follows with everyone.

pages.purpose: Rabbit keeps the escort together beyond the Fork.
pages.beat: Along the final winding stretch, Rabbit checks over his shoulder at each bend and slows whenever the line lengthens; Turtle stays behind instead of passing him.
pages.endingPressure: Only the last bend separates the group from the clearing.
requiredContinuity: The group has left the Fork together and remains on the clearing trail.
Rabbit leads; Turtle follows behind without overtaking.

pages.purpose: The neighbors reach the clearing before moonrise.
pages.beat: At the last bend, Rabbit waits until Turtle and every neighbor draw alongside, then leads them into the clearing while the moon remains below the treetops.
pages.endingPressure: The search and escort are over; the picnic can begin beneath the restored lights.
requiredContinuity: The neighbors, Rabbit, and Turtle arrive together at the clearing before moonrise.
All four lanterns remain correctly placed.

briefs.title: Before Moonrise
briefs.summary: The neighbors reach the picnic clearing before moonrise, and Rabbit and Turtle share the lantern-lit celebration.

pages.purpose: The neighbors begin the picnic together.
pages.beat: In the clearing, Turtle spreads the blanket while Rabbit sets the basket within everyone’s reach, passing the first cups around instead of darting off to choose a treat.
pages.endingPressure: Everyone is settled beneath the lantern glow, and Rabbit has a playful idea.
requiredContinuity: The group remains at the clearing before moonrise.
The picnic begins; all four lanterns remain correctly placed.

pages.purpose: Their different rhythms become a picnic game.
pages.beat: In the lantern glow, Rabbit makes a quick rabbit-shaped shadow with his paws, then slows its wiggle so Turtle can add a steady turtle shadow; the neighbors laugh as the two shapes meet.
pages.endingPressure: The shadows settle, and the playful moment gives way to the warm picnic.
requiredContinuity: Rabbit, Turtle, and the neighbors share the picnic at the clearing.
The four lanterns remain correctly placed along the path.

pages.purpose: Rabbit and Turtle settle into a quiet picnic
pages.beat: Rabbit listens as Turtle offers the first treat; together they enjoy the lantern-lit picnic in quiet ease.
pages.endingPressure: The route is restored, and the picnic is safely underway.
requiredContinuity: The neighbors remain at the clearing before moonrise.
All four lanterns remain restored; the picnic is underway.
